༄༅/ /gsan yig skabs bdun pa bzhugs so/ /sar+b+ba bi dz+nyā na lo ka tsak+ṣu rat+na dhar+m+ma pā la bha dra s+ya pā de pad+mo mu laṃ pra ṇa mya/rab mang legs byas ri

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsan yig skabs bdun pa bzhugs so// sar+b+ba bi dz+nyā na lo ka tsak+ṣu rat+na dhar+m+ma pā la bha dra s+ya pā de pad+mo mu laṃ pra ṇa mya/ rab mang legs byas rin chen chu shel las grub rgyal chen chos kyi mkhyen pa'i cha shas yongs rdzogs shing / /rab gsal dri med thugs rje'i bsil zer sa gsum bde 'byung bcu gnyis nor bu'i 'od zer dang 'grogs nas/ /rab dkar phrin las ku mud gsar pa'i ze 'brus rnam par skyong zhing blo gsal tsa kor 'dzum pa'i mdangs/ thams cad rnam par mkhyen pa'i 'jig rten gyi mig rin chen chos skyong bzang po'i zhabs kyi pad+mo'i drung du rab tu 'dud do/ /rab tu rgyas mdzad 'od gzugs thig le'i zhabs brten 'dab brgya'i ge sar bzang po'i rdul gyis rtag tu skyongs/ snyigs dus gangs ri'i khrod kyi thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis pa rgyal ba'i chos tshul rab 'byams la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros kyi spyan dang ldan pas skal ba bzang por gyur pa'i gdul bya rnams la mchog tu brtse ba'i dmigs med kyi thugs rje chen po rtag tu skyong ba la 'grus pa mi lhod cing legs par sbyar ba'i sgra dang / snyan ngag dang / sdebs sbyor dang ming gi mngon brjod la sogs pa rigs pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa thob pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang po 'gos kyi rigs su sku 'khrungs pa'i zhwa lu lo tsā ba/ rat+na dhar+m+ma pā la bha dra zhes grags pa'i mtshan dkar ches gsal ba gang gi zhabs rdul dri ma med pa la rnam par btud nas/ legs pa bshad pa'i chos kyi bka' drin thob pa'i tshul mdo tsam brjod na thog mar bya ba'i rgyud kyi pad+ma'i rigs su gtogs pa'i tshe dpag med 'chi med rnga sgra zhes grags pa lha gu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ tshe dpag med/ snying po'i zhabs/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa/ byang chub bzang po/ /ting nge 'dzin bzang po/

/rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ mchims brtson seng / rgya zhang phug pa/ 'jad pa shes rab rin chen/ e pa mkhon ston/ 'jam dbyangs bzhi thog pa/ byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/ bla ma grags pa dpal bzang / bla ma chos 'phags rgyal mtshan/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge/ chos rje bu ston rin po che/ sku zhang chos rje nam mkha' mchog grub/ mkhyen rab chos rje/ sgra sgyur chos skyong bzang po/ des dpal sa skya lo tsā ba bdag la'o/ /de'i sgrub dkyil mkhyen rab rin po ches mdzad pa dang / tshe dpag med kyi mdo gzu lo tsā ba dga' ba'i rdo rjes bsgyur ba thos/ bslab btus nas bshad pa'i lus srung ba'i sngags sgra mi snyan pa'i 'chi med kyi rang gzungs zhes grags pa yang thos/ sgra'i bstan bcos slob dpon sha rwa warmas gzhon nu karti ka las thos pa'i ka lā pa'i mdo/ dpang lo tsā bas bsgyur rje nyid kyi ṭī ka'i steng nas sa ris bshad pa dang bcas pa/ de'i cha lag la byings mdo/ u ṇa rtsa 'grel rnams dang / slob dpon btsun pa zla bas mdzad pa'i tsan+d+ra pa'i mdo dpang lo tsā bas bsgyur ba de'i 'grel pa rje nyid kyis mdzad pa/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i mdo/ nyer sgyur nyi shu'i 'grel pa/ byings mdo/ ting mtha'i 'grel pa/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i byings mdo'i don bsdus ka lā pa'i sa bcad/ sdebs sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas slob dpon shān+ti pas mdzad pa/ de'i bsdus don rje nyid kyis mdzad pa/ snyan ngag gi bstan bcos daṇ+ḍis mdzad pa'i me long dang / de'i 'grel pa dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pas mdzad pa/ de'i gsal byed rje nyid kyis mdzad pa/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i bstod pa slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa'i 'jam dbyangs phyogs bcu ma dang / 'khor lo bde mchog gi bstod pa dpal ldan chos grags kyis mdzad pa/ thub pa'i bstod pa rgyun chags dang / yum rgyas pa'i dum bu bzhi dang mthun par bstod pa/

'jig rten las 'das pa/ dpe med pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ sems kyi rdo rje la bstod pa bzhi dang / nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa la bstod pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ gtor ma'i phreng ba blo gros seng ges mdzad pa rnams kyi 'gyur rje lo chen nyid kyis mdzad pa/ mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos sna tshogs gsal ba las nye bar mkho ba rnams rje nyid kyis zur du phyung ba/ nā ro chos drug gi 'khrid yig dang / theg gsum gsal ba gnyis paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rdo rjes mdzad pa/ de nyid la rje lo chen gyis gsan pa rnams kyi lung thob/lha mo dbyangs can ma'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dbyangs can ma/ bram ze phur bu/ gtum mo bde chen/ mchod sdong seng ge/ nyi ma'i seng ge/ dpe med/ rgya mtsho chen po/ sum pa lo tsa ba/ kun dga'/ spyi bo lhas pa byang chub sde/ dam pa shes rab/ gru rdo rje seng ge/ bu ston seng ge 'od/ lha gzhon nu 'bum/ lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ mkhas pa tsan+d+ra shrī/ mkhan chen tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ mkhyen rab chos rje/ rje lo tsā ba/ des bdag la'o/ /nye brgyud ni/ dbyangs can mas rjes su bzung ba'i rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta shri dz+nyā na bha dra mu nān+t+ri/ sa man+ta shrī/ lo tsā ba rin rnam pa man chad sngar dang 'dra/ rjes gnang gi cho ga dang / sgrub thabs rin rnam pas mdzad pa thos/ thub pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi bstod pa lo chen nyid kyis mdzad pa/ 'dul ba'i las chog dri ma med pa'i phreng ba bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa thob/ rnam thos sras zhi drag gi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje/ dpal kun tu bzang po/ /slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po/ /kha che rin chen rdo rje/ kha che dgon pa ba/ zang dkar lo tsā ba/ g.yor po jo ston/ pur bsod nams rin chen/ 'byid phu ba pad+ma bkra shis/

rtag pa jo bzang / lo tsā ba byams pa dpal/ bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug khro phu ba bsod nams seng ge/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge/ bu ston rin chen grub/ lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ slob dpon rin chen dpal grub/ mkhyen rabs chos rje/ sgra sgyur lo tsā ba/ des bdag la'o/ /sgrub thabs dgos 'dod kun 'byung / bstod pa rgyal po mnyes byed/ zhi drag gi rjes gnang gi yi ge rnams thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa/ dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i zhal shes lo tsā ba rin rnam pas mdzad pa rnams kyang legs par thos/ shrī dri ma med pa'i 'od gsal 'chi med kyi gdung las nye bar 'khrungs pa skyed dgu mang po smin grol la 'god par mdzad pa'i bdag nyid/ shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po sad+gu ru pu ṇ+ya dh+wa dza shrī bha bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal sogs kyis bris mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dngos grub 'dod 'jo/ dkyil chog rgyud don rab gsal gyi steng nas/ me mkha' rgya mtsho la 'das lo drug cu skor phrag brgyad dang lo brgyad bsre ba/ yu ba bsti na tshod ldan zhes bya ba'i lo/ rigs ldan gyi rgyal po badz+ra pā no nir+m+ma ṇa sidha phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa seng ges chos ston pa'i skabs shra ba ṇā gro bzhin zla ba'i tshes tir+thi pañtsa da sha la bco lnga/ gza' bṛ hus ti phur bu/ skar ma shra ba ṇā gro bzhin/ sbyor ba so so bha gya/ byed pa gdab pa rnams 'dzoms pa'i dus su/ rdo rje slob dpon sha lu lo tsā rat+na dharma pā la bha dra zhwa lu lo tsā ba rin chen chos skyong bzang po/ zhes bgyi bas/ rdo rje'i slob ma/ shri bhū mi paṇ+ḍū lo tsa mañdzu gho ṣā nan+da pu ṇ+ya kīrti dh+wa dza shrī bha dpal sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dra dpon slob rnams pa ra mā di bud+dha shrī kā la tsakraḥ mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo/

/lha yongs su rdzogs pa'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du byis pa/ 'jug pa'i dbang bdun gyi dbang bskur te/ 'og min gyi srid pa'i mthar thug pa'i 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub bsgrub pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi 'dren pa nyid kyi bsod nams dang ye shes kyi 'bras bu thob pa'i slad du/ lung bstan zhing rjes su gnang ba dang / zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mchog gi nges don gyi dkyil 'khor rnams su dbang gong ma bzhi/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i dbang dang bcas pa rdzogs par thob pa'i brgyud pa thun mong ma yin pa sa lugs ni/ pa ra mā di bud+dha bha ga wā na shrī mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo kā la tsakraḥ bo dhi satwa badz+ra byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying po gar+bha/ badz+ra ḍā ki rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma nī/ tsi lu baṇ+ḍi ta/ dus zhabs che chung / dpe med 'tsho/ sā dhū pu tra/ dharmā ka ra/ dharma mi dra/ bi khyā ta de ba/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya shrī/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ skyus pa gzhon nu seng ge/ dol po ye shes mgon/ kun spangs kun tu bzang po/ /kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin chen grub/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ ru pa ka bzhi pa/ slob dpon bsod grags pa/ rje lo tsā ba/ des zer da dung brtag bdag la'o/ /yang na bu ston/ mkhan chen dhar+m+ma shrī man chad 'og tu 'byung ba bzhin no/ /dus 'khor rwa lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ thub dbang zla bzang lha dbang gzi brjid can/ /zla byin lha yi dbang phyug lha dbang ldan/ /grags pa pad dkar 'jam dbyangs sprul pa dang / /tsi lu pa dang pi to ā tsār+ya/ /dus zhabs rnam gnyis mañdzu kīrti dang / /sa man+ta shrī chos rab ye seng dang / /'bum seng rga lo sher seng rdo rgyal dang / /kun mkhyen bu ston chos dpal 'dus bzang dang /

/dpal legs don grub kun dga' thar pa bzang / /zha lu lo chen dharma pā la yi/ /sa skya lo tsā bdag la babs pa'o/ /'bro lugs ni/ pad dkar yan chad gong bzhin las/ /bzang po rnam rgyal bshes gnyen bzang po dang / /phyag dmar khyab 'jug sbas pa nyi ma grags/ /shin tu bzang po rgya mtsho rnam par rgyal/ /rgyal dka' nyi ma sna tshogs gzugs zla 'od/ /mtha' yas sa skyong dpal skyong dus zhabs gnyis/ /zla mgon dkon mchog srung dang gnam brtsegs dang / /mi bskyod rdo rje chos dbang nam mkha' 'od/ /nam mkha' rgyal mtshan 'jam dpal rga lo'i zhabs/ /sher seng skyi ston kun mkhyen chen po dang / /phyogs las rnam rgyal nya dbon kun dga' dang / /grub chen kun blo 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang / /zha lu lo chen sa skya lo tsā ba/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i bsdus brgyud 'bro lo rtsa bas bsgyur ba las/ jo nang lo tsā ba blo gros dpal dang / blo gros rgyal mtshan gnyis kyi 'gyur bcos pa'i lung gi brgyud pa ni/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo chos rgyal rigs ldan sngar bzhin las/ dus zhabs pa rnam gnyis/ rgyal sras nā len+d+ra pa/ kha che zla ba mgon po/ /'bro lo tsā ba shes rab grags/ lha rje/ sgom pa dkon mchog srung / sgro ston gnam la brtsegs/ grub thob yu mo/ /sras dharma shwa ra/ ma gcig sprul sku jo 'bum/ nam mkha' 'od zer/ se mo che pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam gsar/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ kun spangs kun tu bzang po/ /byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/ mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho/ kun mkhyen shes rab rgyal mtshan/ phyogs las rnam rgyal man gong bzhin/ dus kyi 'khor lo sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs dang / dkyil chog rje bu ston dang / bla ma dam pas mdzad pa gnyis ka'i lung thob/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa rdo rje rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug gi 'khrid thob pa'i brgyud pa'ang gong dang 'dra'o/

/sngon 'gro thog mtha' bar ba'i 'khrid yig rnams dang / ngo sprod gsang don rab gsal dang / yang dag don gsal rnams phyogs rgyal bas mdzad pa dang / bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i 'khrid yig tshang ba/ ngo sprod gcer mthong ngo shes rnams thos shing 'khrid kyi gsung sgros mkhan chen dharma shrī pas mdzad pa/ sbyor drug brgyud pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa'i rim pa bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa dang / rje nyid kyis mdzad pa gnyis ka'i lung yang thos/ rdo rje phag mo shes rab gsal byed kyi byin rlabs dang / sgrub thabs slob dpon kong ka nas mdzad pa/ sa bzang ma tis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang / byin rlabs kyi cho ga rnams kyang thob bo// //bcu bzhi nus ldan nang tshan gyi/ /dpyid kyi thig le'i sdebs sbyor yin/ /sau ran+t+re bodhi man sā ga ra ta sh+shu bhaṃ kṛ h+ya do badz+ra ta him pī shrī ya nā tha ko rat+na dharma pā la bha da nir+m+ma ṇ-itrak+ṣ+ya sar+b+ba dz+nya lo tsa tsugs ma ni pā da na mā me/ legs byas goms pas lha dbang byang chub thugs mchog las/ /nye bar 'khrungs ba'i gangs can dpal mgon 'jig rten mig /rin chen chos skyong bzang por rnam sprul sa gsum gyis/ /gtsug gi nor bu thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /'di yi sngon rol 'phags pa'i yul gyi paṇa chen lha dbang byang chub ces/ /snyan pa'i ba dan dkar pos phyogs kun khebs mdzad gang de da lta'i dus/ /sgra dang snyan ngag sdebs sbyor mngon brjod zlos gar rtsis sogs tha snyad dang / /nang rigs sde snod kun mkhyen grub pa'i dbang phyug ma hā lo tsār 'dud/ /mgon khyod gsan pa'i rgyal mtsho las/ /tha snyad rigs gnas phal cher dang / dang po'i sangs rgyas la sogs pa/ /nges don gdams pa nyer thob pas/ /snyigs dus 'gro ba'i don byed cing / nang la'ang mchog tu gzhol byas nas/ /phyi nang mun pa kun bsal te/ smra ba'i dbang po nyid gyur cig /rgyal ba'i chos tshul dri ma med pa thos pa'i yi ge rin po che pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba las/

rje btsun mkhas pa'i dbang po zha lu lo tsā ba rin chen chos skyong bzang po 'di'i drung du/ sgra snyan ngag sdebs sbyor sogs phyi'i rig gnas dang / dus kyi 'khor lo sogs nang gi zab don mchog rnams thos tshul smos pa'i skabs te bdun pa'o/ /de ltar mkhyen bzang rin chen ngogs su lung dang rtogs pa'i chu rlung kun 'dus dri med legs bshad dbu ba'i phreng ba cher bkra bas/ /mtha' yas skye dgu'i las nyon skom pa'i gdung sel snyan brgyud chu phran stong 'bebs skal bzang mchog la byin rlabs gzi 'od rab 'bar ba'i/ /yid bzhin nor bu sbyin mdzad mkhas shing grub pa'i sa la nges par gnas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la rtag tu phyag 'tshal zhing / /lus srog longs spyod dge ba'i dngos po ci mchis bla med mchod sprin rgya mtshor sprul nas rnam pa kun tu mchod kyis bzhes su gsol/ /tshe rabs kun du dus gsum gyis bskyed rang gi lus ngag yid kyis bsags pa'i sdig dang gzhan la bgyid rtsal yi rangs bgyis pa rnams/ gnong zhing 'gyod pas bshags so phyin chad nyer sdom mos pas spyod dang 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi rnam dkar dge ba kun la yid rangs bgyi/ /dpag med 'gro ba'i don phyir zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo bskul zhing rtag tu mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba rtse gcig 'debs/ /bdag gis thos bsam bsgom gsum spyin dang tshul khrims la sogs legs spyad 'di yis mar gyur sems can kun mkhyen rgyal ba nyid thob shog /kye ma deng sang gangs ri'i khrod 'di na/ /thub dbang nyi mas dngos su ma khyab cing / /thub bstan bdud rtsi'i 'od kyang lhag mar gyur/ /bstan 'dzin rgyu skar phreng ba'ang gzhan du gzhung / /chos min chos ltar bcos pa'i ū lu ka/ /las ngan brag rir nyon mongs tshang bcas nas/ log lta'i hūm̐ sgra drag po 'byin la brtson/ /'dul khrims med par rab byung mkhan slob byed/

/dam tshig ma thob sngags la khrom bshad byed/ /thos bsam byed rnams tshe 'di'i khengs grags 'dod/ /sgom bsgrub byed kyang brnyed bkur kho na'i phyir/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel tshad ma la/ /blta rtog nyan bshad cha tsam mi byed par/ /dus ngan rtog pas bcos pa'i bsdus bsdud la/ /gsung rab dgongs pa 'grel ba'i 'dzin stangs byed/ /lha chung re re'i mngon rtogs sngags shes sam/ /yang na don med ngan sngags kho na 'dren/ /de tsam gyis kyang rdo dril 'khur shes nas/ /dad rdzas gshin zas byung na mgo 'phang bstod/ /nang du bsams na dbang dang rim gnyis kyi/ /rnam gzhag mi shes nyams len ji ltar byed/ /de bas dman pa'i chos gzugs 'dzin pa 'ga'/ /rab byung tshul gyis dmag dpon shes mkhan byed/ /bsam ngan dug sbyor skye bo'i 'gab stegs byed/ /rgyu mtshan med par 'khrug long du ma byed/ /de la smras na khong nas me lce 'bar/ /kha nas tshig ngan du ma tshab tshub 'thul/ /cung zad rnyed na nag chang phyogs su gtong / /dben par bzhag na gnyid dang long gtam sgra/ /yang na sho rtsod don med bya bas 'das/ 'di 'dra'i chos pa rnams kyi byed tshul la/ /mthar thug 'bras bu gang du 'gro ba sems/ /'jig rten pa rnams rang nyid che 'dod nas/ /gzhan dma' 'bebs phyir g.yo sgyu khram gsum gyis/ /g.yog gis dpon bsdu bu tshas pha ma gsod/ /ngo tsha khrel bor gtam ngan khyad bsad nas/ /las ngan sna tshogs spyod cing tshe snga mar/ /las bzang ma bsags tshe 'dir bde skyid med/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas bye bas ma thul ba/ /so so skye bos 'dul ba'i skabs yod dam/ /'di 'dra'i spyod ngan sna tshogs rab mthong nas/ /nges 'byung skyo shas snying rjes kun slangs te/ /thub pa'i bstan la dad pas 'jug 'dod cing / /kho ba'i ngag la nyan na 'di ltar gyis/ /thog mar klog yig mkhas las dag par slobs/ /de rjes mkhan slob mtshan nyid ldan pa las/

/rab byung bsnyen rdzogs 'dul ba'i khrims mnos te/ /dgag sgrub gnang ba'i bslab pa tshul bzhin srungs/ /tshig don 'gal 'brel 'byed phyir sgra tshad slobs/ /sems bskyed cho gas byang chub sems bskyed la/ /gtso bo bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang sems sbyongs/ /bla ma mchog las dbang bzhi'i smin byas nas/ /lam zab rim gnyis bsgom la brtson pa bskyed/ /'bras bu sa dang lam rnams rim bgrod ste/ /bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa thob 'gyur bas/ /'khor ba 'jigs shing lam la sprod skyed nas/ /spro bas 'bad rtsol rab tu bya bar rigs/ /de ltar lam la slob tshul 'di nyid ni/ /rang dgar legs legs 'dra nas bsgrigs pa min/ /shākya'i gsung dang bstan bcos tshad mar bshad/ /khyad par nged kyi bla ma sa skya pa/ /brgyud par bcas pa'i bka' srol rnam dag yin/ /bdag kyang skye ba snga mar las bzang po'i/ /smon lam mtshams sbyar gtsang ma'i rigs skyes nas/ /chung ngu'i dus nas rigs kyi bag chags sad/ rab tu byung 'dod gegs med chos sgor zhugs/ /rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi bka' drin las/ /'khrul med cho gas dbang dang sems skyed blangs/ /nyams len med kyang dam tshig ma nyams tsam/ /khyad par rdo rje 'chang chen rat+na'i mtshan/ /snyigs dus 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog dam pa la/ /sdom pa gsum gyi bka' drin nyer mnos pas/ /bka' drin che zhing bla ma'i mchog tu gzung / /mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs las ches zab pa'i/ /kyai rdor rgyud gsum gsang mtha' gur mgon sogs/ /thun mong ma yin yid ches gnad rnams zhus/ /'jig rten dbang phyug bud+dha rat+na las/ /sngar gyi gdams ngag phal cher bskyar nas nyan/ /gzhan yang gsang 'dus rigs gsum blo sbyong gcod/ /krī ya sa muts+tsha sogs mang du thos/ /mi nyag paṇa chen zhabs las byis pa'i dus/ /dbang dang byin rlabs ci rigs nyung zad nyan/ /mang po'i gsung gi bdud rtsi ma thob kyang / /ma nor bka' srol lam du legs bcug cing /

/shin tu thugs brtse bka' drin bla na med/ /chos kyi rgyal po shes rab rgyal mtshan las/ /rdo rje phur pa'i stod smad dbang sogs zhu/ /chag lo gsum par dus 'khor slob 'dod kyang / /don med rin chen spungs pa'i bar chod kyis/ /bsam pa bzhin du ma grub de lta na'ang / /sgrol ma bla med yang dag la sogs thob/ /'gos lo dharma pā la'i zhal snga nas/ /kā la tsakrī dbang bskur sa lugs dang / /jo zhal lugs kyi sbyor drug 'khrid la sogs/ /kā lā tsan+d+ra rin chen 'byung gnas dang / /sna tshogs gsal ba snyan ngag me long dang / /dpag bsam 'khri shing la sogs tha snyad kyi/ /gtsug lag phal cher zhus shing nan tan gyis/ /rang bzhin rkyen dang rnam 'gyur la sogs pa/ /dus dang don la 'jug tshul ci rigs shes/ /saṃ skṛ ta dang bod kyi klog tshul la/ /snga rabs 'chad tshul rab tu mang na yang / /skyon med 'bri dang brjod pa'i tshul shes pa/ /mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan 'di nyid bka' drin las/ /gzhan la 'chad dang rang nyid nyams su len/ ji ltar byed kyang lag nom mi dgos tsam/ /gsang ston slob dpon yon tan 'bang gnas las/ /'dul ba mdo rtsa kā ri ka la sogs/ /tshad ma rnam 'grel rigs gter sdom gsum dang / /pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung lugs 'ga' zhig thos/ /sngags kyi sdebs sogs lag len phran tshegs bslabs/ /de ltar thos pa'i gzhung lugs thams cad la/ /bsam pas sgro 'dogs bcad cing bsgom na yang / /the tshom mi za yid ches cung zad yod/ /gzhan las mkhas 'dod snyan grags ched du nyid/ /brtsams pa ma yin rang nyid legs bshad la/ /goms pa lhur len rjes 'jug 'ga' zhig la'ang / /phan pa'i don phyir rab tu 'bad pa las/ /byung ba'i legs spyad kun+da'i phung po dang / /bde 'byung ral pa'i gtsug rgyan ltar thob des/ /mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad gnas skabs su/ /rigs gnas lnga la legs par blo sbyangs te/ /dpal ldan sa bcu'i dbang phyug 'grub par shog

/shrī swasti pra dzā bheḥ phun sum tshogs pa'i legs byas stobs bcu'i sku mnga' rnam 'dren dbang dngos sangs rgyas dang / /rnam grol yon tan skyed byed des gsungs 'khor ba'i skyon rnams kun sel dam pa'i chos/ /bslab gsum rin chen do shal gyis mdzes tshogs mchog skyabs gnas dge 'dun 'gyur med bden pa'i stobs/ /bka' stod chos srungs rdo rje'i ye shes spyan gyis kun tu srung zhing 'phral dang yun du bkra shis mdzod/ /'di lta'i byed po rab mchog theg pa chen po'i tshul gnas shākya'i dge slong gang / /dpal ldan sa skya'i lo tsā 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang po zhes grags brda sprod byed pa'i rtsol bas rnam dkar dge ba gang thob des/ /yi ge'i 'du byed tsan+d+ra kīrti la sogs bla med ye shes thob gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dgongs pa mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan nas lo stong phrag gsum dang drug brgya nga bdun 'das shing dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i byed rtsis me mkha' rgya mtsho dag pa'i lo gzhir bzhag nas lo bdun brgya bcu dgu lon pa sa skyong zhes pa shing mo bya'i lo sa ga zla ba'i mar ngo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus tshes bcu bzhi la/ shrī nā len+d+ra chos kyi sder bris pa ānan+ta sar+b+ba sa twaṃ hi tash+tsa su kha bha wan+tu// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ gsan yig skabs bdun pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
